reply_text:
Reviewed `excerpt-helper` (`59856d7`) against `main`. **I’d fix these before merging:**

1. **[P1] Short previews lose text and always get an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`  
   There’s no check for text already within the limit. `excerpt('hello world', 80)` returns `"hello…"`; the same happens at limit `11`. Empty input returns `"…"`. This violates the documented unchanged-text behavior.

2. **[P1] The helpers aren’t connected to cards** — `src/card.js:1–2`  
   `card()` still returns only `entry.body.trim()`. Neither new helper is called anywhere in the card path, so cards continue showing full Markdown bodies rather than plain-text excerpts.

3. **[P2] A word ending exactly at the limit is unnecessarily dropped** — `src/words.js:2–4`  
   The search excludes the space at index `limit`. For example, `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`, even though `"one two"` fits. Include coverage for this boundary; the existing test currently enshrines the incorrect result.

4. **[P2] Markdown stripping deletes literal text** — `src/plain.js:3`  
   Removing every marker character also removes characters that aren’t formatting: `toPlain('snake_case')` returns `"snakecase"`, and an escaped literal `\*` loses its star. Strip Markdown syntax without deleting literal characters.

**Validation:** All four existing tests pass, but targeted checks reproduce the failures above. No files changed.
